page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m4.large is a burstable virtual machine instance belonging to the Shared instance family. Running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 architecture, this instance allocates 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with 2 threads per core on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The CPU subsystem includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 33 MB of shared L3 cache, supporting instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX-512F, AES, and FMA.

The configuration includes 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The instance does not feature local storage, relying on external network-attached block storage for persistent volumes. Baseline network bandwidth is listed at 0 Gbps with no bundled public IPv4 addresses, and no dedicated GPU acceleration is included.

Benchmark measurements reflect baseline burstable resource tiers, with overall CPU and memory throughput tracking in the lower decile of standardized tests. Geekbench evaluates single-core performance at 870.0 and multi-core at 1493.0, while PassMark CPU scores reach 2229.6. Memory throughput tests indicate 16.3 GB/sec on large uncached read blocks and 14.44 GB/sec on writes. Synthetic application tests show Redis SET processing at 2.54 million operations per second and static web throughput at 1.48 GB/sec.

This hardware balance offers qualitative cost economy for environments with sporadic, low-intensity computational needs rather than continuous heavy compute. Suitable applications include low-traffic web servers, development or staging environments, lightweight microservices, and background monitoring utilities.
